disclaimer: This guide was written by Claude (an AI) — not a dictated expert module, not the same trust tier as the Discipline Priest or Feral Druid canonical modules elsewhere on this site. Every ability/cooldown/category/combo-point value is real, live data (resolved from each spell's own current description text and its actual spell_effects rows, not assumed). The Opener/Sustained/CC-Woven/Defensive Ladder/Kingsbane Reset sequences are IMAGINED — my own constructed presses through this real kit, not derived from a real logged match and not something I can actually play to verify. The Real Observed Window section is the one exception: that sequence is measured from real archived matches, not imagined. A real correction from this guide's first version: Kingsbane was described in prose as one of 'the finishers,' then corrected to 'a combo-point builder (+1 CP per cast)' in an earlier revision of this file — that second claim was ALSO wrong. Checked directly against Kingsbane's own spell_effects (2026-09-04): its only resource-related effect is an Energize Power (Energy, not combo points) — base Kingsbane generates zero combo points, full stop. The Opener/CC-Woven sequences above have been corrected to reflect this (Kingsbane no longer credited with +1 CP; downstream running totals recalculated). RESOLVED, not just corrected: a player had reported Garrote/Kingsbane sometimes filling the combo point bar to full in real games. An earlier pass investigated Premeditation as the explanation and found it isn't a selectable talent in this project's data at all — a dead end, correctly abandoned. The real explanation, found the same day this correction was made: Implacable (a genuine, currently-selectable Assassination spec talent — confirmed via talent_node_entries, unlike Premeditation) — 'After striking with Kingsbane, rapidly strike that target 5 times over ~1 second, each strike applies Lethal Poisons and generates a combo point' (confirmed via Implacable Strikes' own spell_effects: 5 strikes at 0.2-second intervals). That's a real, verified 0-to-5 combo-point fill from one Kingsbane cast — matches the reported symptom exactly, not approximately. Important caveat: Implacable is NOT currently selected in Assassination's admin-default TalentBuild, so this mechanic does not apply to whatever kit WoW Comps/Spell Explorer/Burst Guides show by default for this spec right now — the Kingsbane Reset block above is explicitly talent-gated, not part of the base-kit sequences. Whether Implacable is worth prioritizing over whatever the current default build has instead is a real balance/preference question this guide doesn't take a position on.
